title: trace upstream-ref
description: UpstreamRefResolver output at <bundle-dir>/upstream-ref.json. Deterministically (or with LLM-assisted release-notes parsing validated against hard rules) identifies the qualifying upstream fix per §2a of SPEC.md, or records an ineligibility verdict. Patcher treats this document as given truth; Patcher never re-litigates eligibility.

schema_version.description: 1.0.0: original (no prefetch_* fields). 1.1.0: adds prefetch_hashes[] / prefetch_failures[] / prefetch_skips[] / prefetch_kind / derivation_command, plus go-mod-vendor source enum value. Bundles that emit any prefetch_* field MUST declare 1.1.0; legacy 1.0.0 bundles are still accepted.

target_version.description: The upstream version containing the fix. Required when eligibility.verdict == eligible.

fix_tier.description: Classification per §2a. Required when eligibility.verdict == eligible.

prefetch_hashes.description: Deterministically-acquired ground-truth hashes for the resolved upstream target. UpstreamRefResolver owns hash acquisition (e.g. nix-prefetch-url, gh release archive, locked vendor lockfile prefetch) and writes the values here BEFORE the Patcher is invoked. Patcher may emit a hash value in patch.diff ONLY if that exact value appears under prefetch_hashes[].value; any other hash value triggers refusal rule 8. List-shaped because the set of hash-bearing attributes varies by ecosystem (src.hash, vendorHash, cargoHash, npmDepsHash, pnpmDepsHash, yarnDepsHash, cargoSha256, …).

name.description: The Nix attribute name this hash belongs to (e.g. 'src.hash', 'vendorHash', 'cargoHash', 'npmDepsHash'). Patcher matches by exact name.

value.description: The hash value the Patcher is permitted to emit verbatim. Format follows the algorithm: SRI form for sha256/sha512 (e.g. 'sha256-...=') is the v0 default.

source.description: How the hash was acquired, for replay attribution.

prefetch_kind.description: Mechanism class. `url` fetches a single artifact at a URL and hashes it (correct for `fetchurl`-style fetchers; WRONG for `fetchFromGitHub` / `fetchzip` / `fetchgit` because those use fetchzip semantics under the hood). `go-mod-vendor` runs a Nix-overlay build that triggers Go's module-vendoring step and captures the resulting fixed-output hash (output applies to `vendorHash`). `fetchzip` runs a Nix-overlay build that overrides `src.hash` to `lib.fakeHash`, expects the FOD-mismatch error, and parses the real hash out of stderr (correct for fetchFromGitHub / fetchzip / fetchgit / equivalent fetchers; output applies to `src.hash`). `cargo-vendor` runs the same FOD-verify (fakeHash -> got:) against a `buildRustPackage` cargo vendor hash (output applies to a single `cargoHash` / legacy `cargoSha256` slot); v1 supports exactly one straightforward cargo hash slot and refuses `cargoLock.outputHashes`, multiple cargo hashes, or Rust+frontend (npmDeps/yarn) combos. Future kinds (npm-deps, …) will land separately. Required from schema_version 1.1.0 onward; emitters MUST write the field verbatim. Consumers reading legacy 1.0.0 bundles (which don't have this field) should treat absence as `url`.

derivation_command.description: Exact command (or derivation target) used when prefetch_kind != url. Required when prefetch_kind == go-mod-vendor; lets future replay reproduce the acquisition.

url.description: The exact URL the hash was prefetched against, when applicable. Required for source=nix-prefetch-url and source=github-release-archive / gitlab-release-archive.

tool.description: The exact tool binary name invoked to produce the hash. Optional on manually-pinned entries; required when source matches a live-prefetch enum.

tool_version.description: Version string of the tool, captured at fetch time for replay attribution. Recorded verbatim from `<tool> --version`.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp (ISO-8601) when the prefetch ran.

prefetch_skips.description: Structured record of hash slots the resolver KNEW it could not prefetch in v0 (as distinct from prefetch_failures[], which records prefetches that were attempted and failed). Patcher reads this field: a slot listed in prefetch_skips[] with required_for_patch=true is an auditable reason to refuse under rule 8 even when the operator hand-populated other prefetch_hashes[] entries. UpstreamRefResolver writes one entry per skipped slot.

name.description: The Nix attribute name the slot is for (e.g. 'vendorHash', 'cargoHash').

reason.description: Why the resolver skipped this slot. Distinct from prefetch_failures[].reason because nothing was attempted.

required_for_patch.description: True iff the resolver believes a merge-ready patch must update this hash (e.g. vendorHash detected in package.nix when the patch bumps version). When true, Patcher MUST refuse with rule 8 if no grounded value is supplied for the slot via any other channel. False entries are informational.

detail.description: Free-form additional detail for replay / Steward debugging.

prefetch_failures.description: Structured record of prefetch attempts that did NOT produce a usable hash. Recording failures here (instead of on prefetch_hashes[] or omitting silently) lets Patcher's refusal rule 8 fire deterministically while preserving replay attribution. Patcher reads this field for the same reason it reads prefetch_skips[]: a failure entry with required_for_patch=true is an auditable refusal trigger.

name.description: The Nix attribute name the prefetch was for (e.g. 'src.hash').

url_attempted.description: The URL the resolver tried, when applicable.

attempted_command.description: Exact command (or derivation target) attempted. Mirrors prefetch_hashes[].derivation_command for go-mod-vendor failures so that a translated skip preserves attribution.

reason.description: Structured failure reason. v0 enum is small; extend as new failure modes appear.

required_for_patch.description: True iff the resolver believes a merge-ready patch must update this hash (mirrors the prefetch_skips[] semantic). When true, Patcher MUST refuse with rule 8 if no grounded value is supplied for the slot via any other channel.

detail.description: Free-form additional detail (stderr excerpt, exit code, etc.) for debugging. Truncated to 2 KiB.

delta.description: Summary of what else changes between current_version and target_version. Required when eligibility.verdict == eligible so Patcher rationale can quote it.

crosses_large_delta_threshold.description: True if the configured threshold (v0 default: >10 transitive changes OR any new direct dep) is exceeded. If true and the bundle proceeds, kind MUST be human-review-required.

threshold_policy.description: Name of the threshold policy applied, for replay.

verdict_reason.description: Required for any verdict != eligible. Free text citing resolver rules.

human_review_trigger.description: Required when verdict == eligible-requires-human-review. Which rule forced human review.

patch_strategy.description: Resolver-authorized patch strategy. 'version-bump' (default) = bring the package to the fixed release. 'source-backport' = the Patcher AUTHORS the upstream fix as an in-tree patch against the CURRENT version (the resolver also supplies upstream-fix.patch). The Patcher never self-selects this.

allOf.description: Bundles that emit any prefetch_* field MUST declare schema_version 1.1.0. Legacy 1.0.0 bundles cannot use prefetch_* additive fields (the resolver had not yet acquired hashes when the original schema landed).
